tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (453)༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi ba thel lugs lha bcu bdun pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa byin rlabs yang snying zhes bya ba bzhug
(453)༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi ba thel lugs lha bcu bdun pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa byin rlabs yang snying zhes bya ba bzhug

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (453)༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi ba thel lugs lha bcu bdun pa'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa byin rlabs yang snying zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(454)༄༅// bla ma dpal ldan nag po che// thub bstan srung ba'i tshogs kyi rjer// btud nas de sgrub dngos grub kyi// 'byung gnas rjes gnang bcas pa dgod// dpal chen rgwa lo tsā nas brgyud pa'i ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i gdams ngag gi bka' srol mang du bzhugs pa'i nang nas grags che zhing gtso bor gyur pa thel lugs kyi rjes gnang bya ba la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ stegs bu'i steng du dkyil 'khor sgom don dang mthun pa'am/ bsdu na zlum skor gyi nang du/ gru gsum mthing nag lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu can gyi dbus su gtor ma snying gzugs ma mañdzi la bkod/ mthar 'bul gtor lha brangs dang mnyam pa'i gar 'os dang*/ bdud rtsi'i thod pa/ nang mchod sogs dang*/ mchod pa rnams bsham/ shin tu bsdu na/ dkyil 'khor med kyang chog pas/ dpal gyi gtor ma la brten pa kho nas kyang byung ngo*// gnyis pa la/ sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gnyis las dang po ni/ skyabs sems nas brtsam/ 'khor lo bde mchog gi bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung bzlas ba bcas song nas bsdu ldang bya/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi thog mar/ mchod pa rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ (455)swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab la nam mkha'i khams thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badzra ārghaṃ swā hā/ pā dyaṃ/ āñtsa ma naṃ/ pro kṣa naṃ/ puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda/ oṃ badzra ghāṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ sogs kyis byin dbab/ rten yod na de nyid bskyed dgos shing*/ med na gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar bskyed pa yin te/ de yang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddha3haṃ/

stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur khang me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i cung*/ rang gi mdun du dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang bcas shing*/ ro dang ro langs dang srin po dang 'byung po dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis (456)yongs su gang ba'i dbus kyi sa gzhi la rin po che 'bar ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa/ dbus su thod pa 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang zlum po/ steng keng rus kyis phub pa/ phyi nang kun tu rin po che dang*/ lha rdzas kyi gos dang*/ me tog dang*/ zhing lpags nang khrol rus phreng skra'i rnga yab la sogs pa/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi dang 'brel ba'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i dbus su/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan du gyur/ 'di ni las thams cad pa'i gzhal yas khang bskyed tshul rgyas pa yin la/ las re re la las dang mthun pa'i khang pa so so dang*/ bsdu na rgyun 'don la yang dur khrod kyi gzhi kho nas chog pa yin no/ /rang gi snying ga nas hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba zhig 'phros te gdan steng du 'khod/ hūm̐ de nyid kyi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can tshar bcad de gnas spar/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma hā kā la dpa' bo chen po sku mdog mthing nag dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum sdang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril zhing*/ ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ dang phaṭa phaṭa kyi gad rgyangs sgrog pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra ser po me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje gri gug dang*/

g.yon gyi dang pos ka pā la khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba 'debs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon 'og mas tri shū las mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dar dpyangs dang bcas pa 'phyar stabs su bsnams pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ (457)rin po che'i rtse phran dang*/ sbrul rigs bzhi dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan la dpa' bo rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'o// de'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ gsum spros te/ gtso bo'i g.yas g.yon dang*/ mdun grar 'khod pa ni/ las kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag /khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can mi'u thung gi rnam pa rdo rje gnam lcags kyi mchu dang ldan pa'i bya rog gi gdong khro gnyer bsdus shing spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin cing zhal du rngub pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyis dor stabs can/ dug sbrul nag pos brgyan cing*/ skra mtshams nas rdo rje bya khyung spro ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can gsum du gyur/ gtso bo'i g.yas su kṣa las legs ldan nag po/ phyag g.yas tsandan gyi bing chen dang*/ g.yon pas lcags kyi par bu bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber can/ zhabs la sag lh+wam yu ring gsol zhing*/ g.yon brkyang ba/ gser gyi ska rags can/ gtso bo'i g.yon du bhyoḥlas tsaṇḍi kā dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ral gri dang thod khrag /g.yon gnyis mi mgo dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ gcer bu khro zhing sgeg pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo'i mdun du hūm̐ las sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong pa can ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/

g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can/ dar nag gi na bza' dkris pa'o// de'i phyi rol sgo mtshams brgyad du yi ge ma brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma bya rgod kyi gdong pa can/ byang du khyung gi gdong pa can/ (458)nub tu khā ta'i gdong pa can/ lhor 'ug pa'i gdong = shar lhor phag gi= lho nub tu khyi'i= nub byang du spyang ki'i= byang shar du stag gi gdong pa can/ brgyad ka'ang gcer bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i stang stabs sna tshogs pas gnas pa/ 'khor de thams cad kyang dbu skra gyen du brdzes shing spyan gsum pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ mi ro'i gdan la rnam par 'gyings pa med dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyi rol du nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs thams cad kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min dang*/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ na lend+ra/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa nas/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā la'i tshogs// bdag gis thugs dam gnyan skong na// dur khrod gnas nas gshegs su gsol// oṃ badzra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e hye hi oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ padma kam lā ya st+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ mgon po'i spyi bor 'khor lo la oṃ dkar po// mgrin par padma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa ma dzaḥ ārghaṃ nas/ shabda 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes gsungs shing*/ bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag mthu stobs dang nus mthu la dbang bar byas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil (459)pa las/ ye shes mgon po la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ ces dbang bskur cing rgyas gdab/ rgyas par mchod phreng gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ bsdu na/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la ārghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ de bzhin tu/ pā dyaṃ/ āñtsa ma naṃ/ pro kṣa naṃ/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā lā ya/ puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ nai wi dye/ shapta/ zhes phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod 'bul/ hūm̐/ gzi brjid sku yis srid gsum zil gyis gnon// gsung gi bzhad sgras sde brgyad bran du khyol// brtse ba'i thugs kyis 'gro drug dbang du bsdus// lha chen dpal 'bar nag po khyod la bstod// bka' yi pho nya nag po'i gtso// bya rog gdong can 'jigs pa'i gzugs// khros pa'i cha lugs rngams pa'i zhal// dam nyams srog gcod khyod la 'dud// srin po'i tshogs la mnga' bsgyur zhing*// khams gsum srog bdag chen po ni// bdud 'dul tsandan bing chen bsnams// thugs kyi sprul pa khyod la 'dud// dpal ldan lha mo tsaṇḍa kī// lha min mu stegs tshogs 'joms shing*// nad kyi bdag mo drag shul can// srog la dbang bsgyur khyod la bstod// bsil ba'i tshal gyi shing gcig drung*// nag po chen po seng ge'i gdong*// zhing skyong sha za chen po ste// dpal gyi bka' sdod khyod la bstod// gzhan yang mkha' 'gro chen po brgyad// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba sde brgyad bcas// kun la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ ma hā kā la sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod cing dam la bzhag

/gtor chog tsam gyi skabs yin na/ bstod pa brgyad pa lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bton la/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba la 'jug pa yin cing*/ bzlas brjod byed par 'dod na skabs 'dir bzlas pa byas la/ de nas bstod pa byas te gtor ma 'bul ba yin no/ /de la (460)bzlas pa'i dmigs pa yang spyi tsam du/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung*/ zhal nas thon te mgon po'i thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ sngon po gnas pa la thim pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ de las 'od zer sngon po byung ste lte ba nas thon/ rang gi lte ba nas zhugs te thugs srog la thim pas byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam pa do li'i bzlas dmigs 'di kas 'thus shing*/ de la brten nas 'od zer sngags phreng du bsgyur/ bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa nye snying dang*/ oṃ badzra ka wu ba ma hā kā la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang*/ oṃ badzra ka wu wa wa pa sha ya ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces khyad par gyi snying po'o// de nas rtsa sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mgon po bskul ba dang*/ 'khor sngags la mgon po'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'khor rnams bskul/ so so'i sku las sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te phrin las bzhi thogs med du bsgrubs/ khyad par bstan dgra la mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzad par dmigs/ de la/ shā sa na/ rtsa ba'i sngags yin la/ oṃ karma ma ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces las mgon gyi snying po dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso bo las mgon sbrags pa'i snying po dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la ka ka mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ las mgon gyi mtshan sngags dang*/ oṃ ma hā ka la kṣeṃ pheṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ legs ldan bing gi sngags/ oṃ ma hā kā li de wī waṃ hri hūm̐ phaṭa/ tsaṇḍi ka'i snying po dang*/

oṃ ya ma rā dza du tri phu tri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sha za seng ge'i gdong gi sngags so// dregs pa thams cad kyi thun mong gi sngags ni/ gzhi sting du grags pa yin te/ man ngag gi yi ge rnams su shes par bya'o// de nas da lta rkang brgyad du grags pa zhing skyong gi sngags kyi sgo nas bstod pa ste/ bstod pa brgyad pas bstod par bya ste/ de yang*/ dpal nag po chen po la phyag 'tshal lo// hā hā hūm̐ yig sgra dang ki li ki li'i sgra sgrogs ro langs 'byung pos bskor/ (461)hūm̐ hūm̐ mdzad cing kun nas mi shas zhal dang sgyu ma'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs ba'i sku// phyag na mdud dang kha ṭwaṃ mi thod 'dzin pa 'dod pa'i gzugs can mi sdug gzugs// spyan ni ser zhing skra ser ro yi 'dus la dgyes shing zhing skyong khyod kyis srungs// zhal nas pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ yig sgra dang so sor bskyed pa'i me chen mchog gi dbus// rab gsal 'jigs pa'i sku dang yan lag mgo phreng nye bar mdzes pa'i rgyan du mdzad// bsad pa'i mi mgo khrag 'dzag dum bu drag po'i phyag gis 'dzin cing mchod yon 'thung*// mi yis gang ba'i sa la zhing skyong khyod ni rol zhing rol zhing rtsed mos srung*// kṣiṃ kṣiṃ kṣiṃ rang ca co sgrogs mdzad bzod pas gdug can rnams 'ching bzod pa'i sku// char sprin sngo mdog ka ha ka ha brjod mdzad gcig pus sna tshogs gnon cing gnon// kṣiṃ kṣiṃ shrīṃ sngags sku can pa tsa pa tsa bsreg mdzad kun nas sngags kyi rigs// sgrub pa rnams kyi bgegs rnams skrod cig nges par zhi bar mdzod cig zhing skyong kye// hā hā hār bzhad gad rgyangs phul byung phyugs rnams dus kun 'jigs par mdzad pa gang*// 'jig rten rnams kyi bgegs 'joms nyin rir dri med rab thob rdzogs pa'i byang chub brnyes// hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra skad drag po'i nus mthus srid pa gsum khongs gang bar 'gengs// srungs shig zhing skyong sma ra ral pa dbu skra kham ser ldan pas nye bar bsgrubs// khaṃ khaṃ khaṃ 'gying sgeg rol lto ba 'phyang ba phyag na ral gri khrag 'thung ba// raṃ raṃ raṃ ni spyan dmar gtum shugs phyag gis ru ru'i khrag la spyod par mdzad// kruṃ kruṃ kruṃ khros lta stangs mdzod cig ma lus bdud rnams 'khums pa'i khro gnyer mdzod// ḍaṃ ḍaṃ ḍaṃ 'dis 'dul mdzad cang te'u ldan pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis srung bar mdzod// kraṃ kraṃ kraṃ mdzad bdud dang dgra bo nyon mongs bag chags ma lus nges par 'joms// ka ྃkam̐ kam̐ gi sku ni nag (462)po'i mchu mtshungs rtsod dang nyes 'phrog thod phreng can// tsaṃ tsaṃ tsaṃ cher rab g.yo rmad byung sa gzhi 'jig rten snang byed gtum po'i shugs// saṃ saṃ saṃ bdag dge 'dun dam tshig dge bar spyod la zhing skyong khyod kyis srungs// yaṃ yaṃ yaṃ 'gro sna tshogs dri med chu bzhin gzigs nas nges par gshin rje 'gog

/baṃ baṃ baṃ ni 'jig rten rab skyod skad cig rlung shugs glog ltar rab tu mkhyen// bhūṃ bhūṃ bhūṃ 'jigs khro gnyer mchog mdzad sgrub po rnams la 'jigs pa las grol ster// kṣaṃ kṣaṃ kṣaṃ ni gnod pa ring du skad cig la zad bde mdzad zhing skyong kye// klaṃ klaṃ klaṃ gang dul ba'i lus can srid gsum 'gro ba dus kun nyon mongs rnams// paṃ paṃ paṃ mdzad phyag gi zhags pas phyugs rnams 'dzin cing gdul bya rnams skyong ba// sngags bdag sngags kyi lus can zhi bde'i 'bras ster sngags pa rnams la sngags dang mtshungs// zhing rnams skyong ba khyod kyis lus can skye bo mtha' dag gang 'dir yun ring skyong*// sngags rnams brgyad po thun gsum du ni klog byed nges pa mkhas pa'i glo can gang*// slob dpon dang ni sgrub po'ang dam tshig dge ba spyod rnams rgyal 'gyur bsod nams ldan// tshe dang dpal dang grags dang 'byor ldan mnyam med stobs 'dzin rnam gnon 'od rgyas te// de yis bgegs tshogs nyams shing mtshungs med thams cad shes pa nyin mtshan rtag tu ster/

/ces rgyud kyi sngags 'grel 'phags zhabs kyis mdzad pa ste 'di la 'gyur mi gcig pa mang ngo*// de nas gtor ma/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ kam̐ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ka bā la yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu shu mar las bdud rtsi lnga/ thod pa'i steng du zla ba'i kha gcod hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa'i rdo rjes brgyan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃ dkar po rnams (463)steng nas steng du brtsegs pa rnams mgo bo thur bstan/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing 'dres/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros/ gtor ma'i steng gi 'bru gsum la phog /las rim gyis gtor ma la thim pas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi sngo dmar dkar po'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rdo rjes bdud rtsi lan gsum dud krugs/ rdo rjer lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te gnyis su med par thim/ rdo rje yang zhu zhing 'dres pa las/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badzra ma hā kā la i daṃ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis gtso bo dang*/ 'khor rnams la spro na/ snying po lan gsum gyis dbul zhing*/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thun mong du/ rtsa sngags kyis 'bul ba ni/ oṃ shri badzra ma hā kā la/ shā sa na u pa ha ri ṇi e ṣa3 pañtsi ma/ kā lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ ratna tra yā ya/ a pa ka ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra ti dzñā/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣṭaṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛ hṇa gṛ hṇa/ bandha bandha/

ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mo/ 'di ni rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ 'bring po ltar na/ shā sa na gcig pus chog /bsdus pa ltar na/ gtso bo'i gtor sngags thung ngu des kyang chog go /gtor chog kho na'i skabs/ de rjes 'dod don gsol btab sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o// gnyis pa rjes gnang ni/ slob ma rnams la phyi rol du chab btang*/ phyag bcas gral du 'khod/ me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal gdab/ de yang dpal rdo rje nag po chen pa ོ phyag bzhi pa 'di nyid nges pa'i don du dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dang rnam dbyer med cing gdug pa 'dul phyir khros pa'i tshul bstan pa ni rgyud las/ (464)dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa yi// gsang gsum las sprul nag po che// zhes gsungs shing*/ ston pa rdo rje 'chang chen pos legs par gsungs pa'i dpal ye shes kyi mgon po chen po'i rgyud rnams mi yul du spyan 'dren pa po ni thog mar slob dpon klu sgrub yin te/ de yang lho phyogs bai darbhar sku 'khrungs/ rigs ni bram ze/ na landar mkhan po sgra gcan 'dzin gyis rjes su bzung*/ rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag la mi mkhyen pa med par byas te mkhas pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur/ rma bya chen mo dang*/ ku ru ku lle dang*/ gnod sbyin mo dgu dang*/ nag po chen po rnams bsgrubs pas dngos grub mtha' dag brnyes/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes chen por gyur/ nag po chen po'i rig sngags grub nas/ dha n+yaka ḍa ka'i gling nas nag po chen po'i rgyud rnams spyan drangs/ gzhan yang lha mo nag mo'i rgyud dang*/ ku ru ku lle'i rtog pa sogs dang*/ gzhan yang sgrub thabs mi gcig pa brgya drug cu spyan drangs par grags/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams las zhal gyi gdams pa thob pa sogs/ mdor na slob dpon chen po de ni 'phags pa'i sa brnyes pa'i phyir 'phags pa klu sgrub ces bya'o// klu sgrub zhabs kyis/

klu'i byang chub sogs rjes su bzung*/ slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras dang*/ slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas sogs kyis kyang bstan srung gi gtso bor mdzad/ rgyud 'grel man ngag ci rigs pa bod du spyan 'dren pa po lo tsā ba ci rigs byung ba'i nang nas/ 'dir dpal rgwa lo tsā ba zhes grub pa'i dbang phyug chen por gyur pa de'i lugs rtsa bar bzung*/ de la slob ma zhang tshal pa/ phag gru pa/ byal stong pa/ ai sang cog ro sogs mang yang thel gyi lugs mchog tu bsngags pa de yin/ 'di la smin byed rgyas pa bum dbang bcu bzhi pa dang*/ dbang bzhi'i rigs 'ga' zhig kyang bzhugs pa las bka' yangs shing byin rlabs (465)kyi babs shin tu che la zab pa'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la bdag nyid kyis bgyi bar 'os pa rnams grub zin/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa thog mar zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇḍal phul mdzod/ ces par sbyar la maṇḍal phul du gzhug /de nas slob dpon bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog dngos su gsal ba la mos gus byas te thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa dang*// log 'dren bgegs rnams tshar gcod phyir// mgon po'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ zhes lan gsum/ de nas rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du/ mdun bskyed dpal ye shes mgon po'i dkyil 'khor rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro bas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum/ de nas rjes gnang dngos la sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang so so'i byin rlabs 'bebs ba dang bcas pa rnams su yod pa las/ dang po sku'i rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar du mdzod/

bla ma he ru ka'i thugs nas 'od zer sngon po thog lhung ba ltar byung ste/ slob ma'i lus la g.yon bskor lan gsum byas nas/ spyi bor thim pas/ ma dag pa'i lus sbyangs te/ 'od zer mthing ga'i phung po chen por gyur/ de las dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis mgon po'i skur gsal btab/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ bsil ba tshal/ na lend+ra/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa nas/ (466)ye shes pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'ur 'ur chem chem gyi sgra dang bcas te byon/ slob ma'i lus la thim pas/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsam zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ sngags drag tu bzla/ de nas dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ ārghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs sgrub thabs kyi dbang bskur ltar la/ oṃ badzrī bha ba zhes pa'i skabs ka pā la bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbur brgyan par gyur/ de ni sku'i rjes gnang sku'i byin rlabs 'bebs pa dang bcas pa'o/// /gnyis pa gsung gi rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar du mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus dung byas pa las thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ yig sngags phreng sngon pos bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams mgon por gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig sngon po'i mthar 'khod/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par byon te thugs ka'i sngags phreng la thim par mos la sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos/

nye snying yi ge bcu pa dang*/ shā sa na 'i rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug /de nas khyed rang rnams kyis slob dpon la me tog gi phreng ba re phul bar mos la 'di'i rjes zlos/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ me tog de nyid sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs te khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bcings par mos shig /me tog spyo bor bzhag/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la dpal rdo rje nag po chen (467)po phyag bzhi pa'i gsung rig sngags kyi nus pa thams cad 'jug par gyur cig /bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang bsil ba tshal la sogs pa nas/ sngags kyi yig 'bru dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ slob ma'i snying ga'i sngags phreng la bstim pas ngag gi sdig sgrib dag /gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam la/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ gsung gi rjes gnang gsung gi byin rlabs 'bebs pa dang bcas pa'o/// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar mdzod/ bla ma yi dam mdun bskyed dang bcas ba la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ bla ma'i thug ka nas 'od 'phros rang lus la thim/ lus yas mas nas rim pas zhu ste/ snying ga'i sngags 'khor la thim/ de hūm̐ la/ de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ nā da yang mi snang bar gyur pa la mnyam par bzhag /yang hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sgras/ slob ma mgon po'i sku rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ slob dpon la mos gus dungs pa byas pas thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ mdun bskyed dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ bsil ba tshal la sogs pa nas/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi phyag mtshan so so dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ dgra bgegs bsgral ba la sogs pa'i las mdzad/ slob ma'i snying gar thim pas/

yid kyi sdig sgrib dag /thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam la rol mo'i sgra bya/ thugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ thugs kyi byin rlabs 'bebs pa dang bcas pa'o/ /de nas gtor ma dpal 'bar can slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzung la/ phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod// gtor snod dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i nang du gtor ma ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa lha bcu bdun 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas par gsal thob/ (468)de'i steng du slob dpon dang 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor dbyer ma mchis pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor bar sgoms shig /bla ma yi dam gyi tshogs kyis chos skyong srung ma rnams la bka' bsgos pas/ de rnams kyis rdo rje'i bro drag po bkrabs pas/ dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar brlag par mos pa gyis/ zhes brjod la/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas te/ bstod pa brgyad pa tshar gcig dang*/ shā sa na dang sngags rnams tshar gcig drag tu brjod pa'i rjes la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa lcam dral bran g.yog bka' sdod pho nya las mkhan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ārya de ba/ slob dpon rta dbyangs/ rdo rje gdan pa/ a bha yā ka ra/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags/ dpal chen rgwa lo tsā/ dpal ldan phag mo grub/ stag lung thad pa chen po// 'gro mgon sangs rgyas rnam gsum la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar slob ma 'di'i srung ma chen po mdzod la/ lus dang grib ma bzhin tu 'grogs te/ 'gal rkyen bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sol/ mthar rkyen chos bzhin gyi bsam don mtha' dag yid bzhin tu sgrubs/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnam pa gnyis bde blag tu 'grub pa'i sdong grogs g.yel ba med par mdzad du gsol/

ces bka' bsgo bya/ mthar bla ma rnams yi dam la thim/ de rnams mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas slob ma la thim par gyur/ ces dpon slob gnyis car gyis bsgom/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs par brjod/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o// gtor dbang kho na byed par 'dod na/ gsol btab rgyun bshags song ba'i rjes la/ slob ma'i blo'i ngor/ gtor ma mgon por bskyed cing spyan drangs/ de nas gong bzhin gtor ma'i bka' bsgo nyid byas pas kyang bar chad sel ba'i thabs mchog tu 'gyur zhing*/ (469)mchod gtor 'bul ba sogs la dbang ba yin no// yang chos skyong du mi bsten par bar chad sel ba tsam don du gnyer ba la/ bka' bsgo'i skabs srung ma mdzod ces pa por/ mgon po slob ma la bstim pa'i dmigs pa mi dgos so// /gsum pa rjes chog ni/ gtor ma dang*/ mchod pa kha gsos la/ byin rlabs nas brtsam gtor 'bul gang ltar dang*/ phyi nang gi sngags mchod 'bul/ bstod pa bsdus pas bstod/ rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'dod dgu byung ba'i rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi dka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ sems can la bde skyid kyi dpal rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gi bsam sbyor phun tshogs chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing*/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa la sogs pa phrin las rnam pa bzhi g.yel ba med par mdzad du gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang*/ sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ brtan yod na brten bzhugs bya/ med na badzra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ ādma ka tiṣṭha hūm̐/ zhes brjod la smon lam dang bkra shis rgyas par bya'o// srid gsum bgegs rigs kun nyams shing*// grub pa rnam gnyis bde blag 'grub// nag po che dang dbyer med par// rgyal bstan srung ba'i mthu thob shog

/ces gangs ljongs sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi khrid srol gces par bsdus pa gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod las mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi chos srung gi gtso bor bsngags pa 'di la rgyud gzhung man ngag mtha' yas pa bzhugs pa las/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi snying po jo nang rin 'byung du bzhugs pa las zur phyung bklags chog gi tshul du karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang du bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/// /(470)
